summary: Frontend-only verification of the compact per-member Vigilance Report table restructure. Verified as ADMIN (admin/HrAdmin@2109) at /vigilance and as Vigilance Employee (madhan.s/Vigil@123) at /employee/vigilance for date range 2026-09-01..2026-09-30, plus normal-employee denial (user/pass123). All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: OperationalVigilance.js is now 1193 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline for splitting. Consider extracting AdminMergedTable, VigilanceOwnTable, FragmentCols/FragmentData, PaginationBar and the Add/Edit dialog into separate files under /pages/vigilance/ for maintainability. No functional impact this iteration.

verifications.admin_base_columns_order: Name, Date, Team, Punch-In, Punch-Out, Total Hours (all rowSpan=2) then per-uploader group headers then Actions
verifications.admin_dynamic_uploader_groups: 2 groups rendered (Dinesh T, Madhan S) — exactly matches uploaders returned by GET /api/vigilance/entries. Nothing hardcoded (uploaders come from data.uploaders).
verifications.admin_per_member_subcols: Each group has exactly 2 sub-columns labelled 'Research' and 'Total Break'. Total per-uploader sort headers = 4 (2 uploaders x 2). Matches formula 6 + uploaders*2 + 1.
verifications.old_wide_columns_gone_admin: No 'Sys In', 'Sys Out', 'Morning', 'Lunch', 'From' text found in vig-admin-table header.
verifications.data_mapping_correct: Screenshot verified: e.g., Suyash Pandey 07-Sep-2026 row shows Dinesh T (01:25 / 01:07) and Madhan S (01:25 / 01:07) each under its own group; Mannan Pathak 04-Sep shows Dinesh T (02:38 / 00:00) and Madhan S (02:38 / 00:00). Values displayed are drawn from subByUp[uploader.employee_id] — one member's data does not appear under another. Empty submissions render '—' (muted).
verifications.sorting_works: Base sort headers vig-sort-name/date/team/punch_in/punch_out/total_hours all present. Per-member sort headers (data-testid vig-sort-up:<uid>:total_research_hours and vig-sort-up:<uid>:total_break_hours) present for both uploaders and clickable (verified click).
verifications.view_edit_dialog_detail_preserved: Admin vig-admin-view-btn opens vig-entry-dialog with a 'Breaks' section and full form controls (System Login, System Logout, Total Research Hours, Total Break Hours, Breaks list). Own view vig-view-btn/vig-edit-btn also opens vig-entry-dialog with 'Breaks' section — detailed break data was NOT deleted, only hidden from main table.
verifications.delete_confirm_still_opens: vig-admin-delete-btn opens vig-confirm-delete dialog (cancelled without deleting).
verifications.own_view_layout: vig-own-table headers: band row [Employee, Attendance, Vigilance, Actions] + labels [Name, Date, Team, Punch-In, Punch-Out, Total Hours, Research Hours, Total Break]. No Sys In/Out or break From/To/Total columns. colCount=9. Row actions vig-view-btn/vig-edit-btn/vig-delete-btn all present.
verifications.regression_buttons: vig-filter-btn, vig-reset-btn, vig-filter-employee, vig-export-btn, vig-download-template-btn, vig-help-btn, vig-add-entry-btn, vig-prev-page, vig-next-page, vig-rows-per-page — all present.
verifications.permissions_denial: Normal user (user/pass123): /vigilance -> /employee/dashboard (no vig-admin-table); /employee/vigilance -> /employee/dashboard (no vig-own-table). Redirect + hidden data confirmed.
verifications.responsive_390px: At 390px viewport, document.documentElement.scrollWidth == innerWidth (390) — no page-level horizontal overflow. Table itself is inside a horizontal scroll container.
verifications.shift_wheel_horizontal_scroll: Non-passive wheel handler is registered (onWheel with { passive: false } in useEffect at line ~232-245 of OperationalVigilance.js). Interactive dispatch of a synthetic WheelEvent from an already-authenticated context could not be re-verified after session drift, but code path is present and correctly attached.
verifications.console_errors: Only benign pre-login 403 notification-bell noise (expected per agent note), no runtime errors on Vigilance page.
